scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @stream/api" "npm run dev -w @stream/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @stream/api && npm run lint -w @stream/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @stream/api && npm run test -w @stream/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stream/api && npm run typecheck -w @stream/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
